entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: Hear attentively my speech, and let this replace your consolations.

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Suffer me and I will speak; and after I have spoken, mock on!

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: As for me, is my complaint to a man? or wherefore should not my spirit be impatient?

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay the hand upon the mouth.

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: Even when I think [thereon], I am affrighted, and trembling taketh hold of my flesh.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: ¶Wherefore do the wicked live, grow old, yea, become mighty in power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their seed is established with them in their sight, and their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of +God upon them.

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They shout to the tambour and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: They spend their days in prosperity, and in a moment go down to Sheol.

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: And they say unto *God, Depart from us, for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways!

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: What is the Almighty that we should serve him? and what are we profited if we pray unto him?

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked be far from me!

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: ¶How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, and cometh their calamity upon them? Doth he distribute sorrows [to them] in his anger?

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: Do they become as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away?

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: +God layeth up [the punishment of] his iniquity for his children; he rewardeth him, and he shall know [it]:

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the fury of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what pleasure should he have in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: Can any teach *God knowledge? And he it is that judgeth those that are high.

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet;

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His sides are full of fat, and the marrow of his bones is moistened;

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, and hath not tasted good:

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: Together they lie down in the dust, and the worms cover them.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: ¶Lo, I know your thoughts, and the devices ye wrongfully imagine against me.

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For ye say, Where is the house of the noble? and where the tent of the dwellings of the wicked?

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: Have ye not asked the wayfarers? and do ye not regard their tokens:

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: That the wicked is reserved for the day of calamity? They are led forth to the day of wrath.

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: Yet is he carried to the graves, and watch is kept over the tomb.

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him; and every man followeth suit after him, as there were innumerable before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: How then comfort ye me in vain? Your answers remain perfidious.
